seo.title: The Parish
seo.description: The history of Saint Anthony of Padua Parish in Dois Vizinhos, Brazil, the main church, the parish office and the Diocese of Palmas – Francisco Beltrão.

hero.title: A story that began with the faith of those who arrived first.
hero.lead: Saint Anthony of Padua Parish was born alongside Dois Vizinhos. Today it brings together the main church, rural communities and city neighborhoods.

history.title: Before the town, the faith.
history.lead: The first settlers arrived in a land of dense forest carrying little — and their devotion to Saint Anthony.

milestones.text: The first devotees of Saint Anthony arrive in the small village that would later become Dois Vizinhos.
The chapel on the former Ademar da Costa Machado Square, today Ari Jaime Muller Square, becomes Saint Anthony of Padua Parish.
Rural areas and city neighborhoods welcome their patron saints and form the communities that make up the parish today.
The parish lives on in its communities, ministries and movements, as part of the Diocese of Palmas – Francisco Beltrão.

history.source: Source: “History of the 40 years of Saint Anthony of Padua Parish”, by Valdir Luiz Pagnoncelli.

matrix.title: The community's home.
matrix.lead: In the center of Dois Vizinhos, the main church gathers the parish for the Eucharist, the patron's feast, the sacraments and pastoral life.

office.title: We're here to help.
office.lead: Baptisms, weddings, documents, Mass intentions and conversations with the priests.

diocese.description: The parish belongs to the Diocese of Palmas – Francisco Beltrão, in the South II Region of the Brazilian Bishops' Conference, which gathers the parishes of southwestern Paraná.
